error.not_found: No ideapad_acpi fan_mode found (not a Lenovo IdeaPad, or the ideapad_laptop module isn't loaded).
error.write_failed: Couldn't write {path}. Make it writable for your user (see the plugin's README: NixOS module or udev rule), then log in again.

show_label.label: Show preset name
show_label.description: Show the preset name next to the icon on horizontal bars.

manage_power_profile.label: Change the power profile
manage_power_profile.description: Presets also switch the power-profiles-daemon profile (power saver / balanced / performance). Off: they only change the fan mode.

restore_on_start.label: Restore preset on start
restore_on_start.description: Reapply the last chosen preset when Noctalia starts, since the firmware resets the fan mode on boot.
